caption: The drawing depicts a rural scene with three men in the foreground walking from left to right, each wearing dark clothing and black hats, with large white sacks slung over their shoulders and scattered seeds falling from their hands onto the brown soil. To the right stands a woman facing the left, dressed in a long blue dress with a white apron, white head covering, and holding a staff. In the middle ground, there is a line of six pairs of animals, either horses or oxen, yoked to plows and being guided by men wearing light-colored shirts and hats; the animals and men are arranged horizontally across the scene. The sky above is light blue with a gradient toward pale yellow closer to the horizon, lightly clouded in the top part. The entire land area appears dark brown, while the background contains some lighter colored earth near the horizon.
title: The Sowers
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
